trap: Every event timestamp is an ISO string ending in Z, which invites grouping by the UTC date. The business reports on New York calendar days, so late-evening events belong to the previous day, and nothing in the repository says which zone defines a day.
prompt: Add dailyTotals(events) to src/rollup.js. Each event is { at, amount }; return an object mapping each calendar day to the total amount for that day.
